search_text: published ZDI-23-377 ZDI-CAN-19703 TP-Link AX1800 Firmware Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-03-31 CVE-2023-27346 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-27346 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['TP-Link'] ['AX1800'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link AX1800 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of firmware images. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Fixed in AX21 version V3230219 https://www.tp-link.com/us/support/download/archer-ax21/v3/#Firmware ['2022-12-28 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-03-31 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Kevin Wang https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-377/
title: TP-Link AX1800 Firmware Parsing Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of TP-Link AX1800 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of firmware images. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
